prompt: In multi-tenant projects a GraphQL query sometimes returns data from the wrong tenant. It happens when one field of a query temporarily switches tenant through `TenantContext.withTenant()`, `withRootTenant()` or `withEachTenant()` (for example to load inherited permissions or a profile from the parent tenant) while a sibling field of the same query is still resolving: the sibling reads the switched tenant instead of the request's own. Fix the leak so a temporary tenant switch is visible only to the code running inside its callback. Calling `setTenant()` inside such a callback must be rejected with an error and leave the request's tenant unchanged.
notes: Repo notes: this is the Webiny monorepo (Yarn workspaces, Node 24). Dependencies are installed and every package is already built. Yarn is not on PATH; run it as `node .yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs <command>` from the repo root. Test a package: `WEBINY_STORAGE=ddb node .yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs test packages/<folder>` (storage values: `ddb`, `sql`, `ddb-os,ddb`; storage-backed suites are skipped without it; OpenSearch is running on localhost:9200). Type-check a package: `node .yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs check -p @webiny/<name>`. After changing a package, rebuild it so other packages see the change: `node .yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs build -p @webiny/<name>`. Do not commit or push anything.
